recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If the work group wants to rename the historical consent-policy value set title/name that still contains "PolicyRule", handle that as a separate editorial/terminology cleanup because it is not a remaining URI-vs-CodeableConcept defect.
issue_request: FHIR-13358 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent. It requested changing Consent policyRule from opt-in/opt-out URI magic values to a CodeableConcept based on ActConsentDecision, retiring those magic URIs, and correcting examples/text; its resolution also satisfied duplicate FHIR-13598.
initial_application: Commit e0f2ea28e4dbe6b1fc2ff9d32ef6f84347cc8ef5 explicitly applied the seed by updating Consent examples and source definitions from ConsentPolicy opt-in/out URI values to CodeableConcept policyRule codings.
additional_context: FHIR-13598 is a duplicate request for Consent.decision/ActConsentDirective support. Later Published issue FHIR-32817 changed the old policy/policyRule model into regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, policyText, and explicit decision/provision semantics. Consent is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini, and the R4/R6 mapping records the old policyRule as moved to current policy text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml defines regulatoryBasis as CodeableConcept, policyBasis as a backing-policy Reference/uri, policyText as human-readable policy references, and decision as permit/deny; targeted search found no active <policyRule> element or old http://hl7.org/fhir/ConsentPolicy/opt-in or /opt-out URI usage.
